"Welcome to Your Healthy Place"​  | PrimeCareHealth (PrimeCare) is a federally qualified community health center (FQHC) that provides quality, affordable care to medically underserved populations on Chicago’s West and Northwest sides. Over its 22-year history, PrimeCareHealth has built a community-inspired, nationally recognized health care system that provides comprehensive family medical care at its five accessible locations, including health services for adults, seniors, women and children, as well as prenatal health services, behavioral health counseling, and case management, regardless of patients’ ability to pay.

Our clinics and  health centers are staffed with trained medical professionals, including physicians, residents, nurses, case managers, care coordinators and service support staff.

profile_projects: [{"description":"In September 2024, I completed the Iron Phi Challenge by running, swimming, biking, and paddling 200 miles in 10 days to raise awareness for ALS research. This effort was inspired by Phi Delta Theta's commitment to supporting those affected by Lou Gehrig's disease. I averaged 21 miles daily, balancing early-morning training while being a full-time student and fortunate enough to be sponsored by Subaru Pacific.The journey combined physical endurance and mental resilience, especially during open-water challenges. My fraternity brothers provided unwavering support, allowing me to focus on completing the challenge and honoring Kathy Troeger, a community member we had been supporting who tragically passed from ALS.This project raised awareness for ALS while uniting my fraternity and the campus community around a meaningful cause, culminating in a final celebratory mile run at LMU's Sunken Gardens.","end_date":"Sep 2024","start_date":"May 2024","title":"Miles For Miracles: 200 Miles To Defeat ALS"},{"description":"My journey began with a simple \"what if?\" - an idea that evolved into a profound venture. Initially uncertain, I was propelled by immense support from peers and the community. Starting with limited experience and basic equipment, I embarked on an ambitious Senior Project, documenting it all.As I formalized the project and witnessed overwhelming backing, I upped my game, investing in top-tier equipment. This leap led to the birth of Be True Luxury Media (BTLuxeMedia), a registered media production business in Los Angeles. The venture rapidly gained traction, eventually expanding throughout Southern California.11 months of relentless dedication, capturing over 5 terabytes of content, and investing around 240 hours in post-production, this venture has been a labor of love for my community. Mira Costa and the Manhattan Beach community provided the perfect canvas to nurture my passion, and I'll forever cherish this pivotal starting point in my career. Thank you, Mira Costa HS and Manhattan Beach!","end_date":"Aug 2023","start_date":"Jul 2022","title":"Mustangs Forever - Senior Year Documentary"}]

profile_publications: [{"date":"November 20, 2017","description":"Despite their immense and rapidly increasing importance as analytical tools or therapeutic drugs, the detailed structural features of particular monoclonal antibodies are widely unknown. Here, an antibody already in use for diagnostic purposes and for molecular dosimetry studies in cancer therapy with very high affinity and specificity for cisplatin-induced DNA modifications was studied extensively. The molecular structure and modifications as well as the antigen specificity were investigated mainly by mass spectrometry. Using nano electrospray ionization mass spectrometry, it was possible to characterize the antibody in its native state. Tandem-MS experiments not only revealed specific fragments but also gave information on the molecular structure. The detailed primary structure was further elucidated by proteolytic treatment with a selection of enzymes and high resolution tandem-MS. The data were validated by comparison with known antibody sequences. Then, the complex glycan structures bound to the antibody were characterized in all detail. The Fc-bound oligosaccharides were released enzymatically and studied by matrix-assisted laser desorption/ionization mass spectrometry. Overall 16 different major glycan structures were identified. The binding specificity of the antibody was investigated by applying synthetic single and double stranded DNA oligomers harboring distinct Pt adducts. The antibody–antigen complexes were analyzed by mass spectrometry under native conditions. The stability of the complex with double stranded DNA was also investigated.","subtitle":"Mol. Pharmaceutics, 2017, 14 (12), pp 4454–4461","title":"Comprehensive Molecular Characterization of a Cisplatin-Specific Monoclonal Antibody"},{"date":"November 9, 2017","description":"Quantitative analysis of complex proteins is a challenging task in modern bioanalytical chemistry. Commonly available isotope labels are still suffering from limitations and drawbacks, whereas new metal labels open numerous possibilities in mass spectrometric analyses. In this work, we have developed a new metal labeling strategy to tag glycan structures of proteins, more particularly antibodies. The oligosaccharide glycans were selectively trimmed to the last N-acetylglucosamine to which an artificial azide containing galactose residue was bound. This azide can be used for subsequent cycloaddition of an alkyne. Therefore, we developed a lanthanide-containing macrocyclic reagent to selectively connect to this azido galactose. In summary, the glycan structures of an antibody can be labeled with a metal functionality using this approach. Furthermore, the functionality of the antibodies can be fully maintained by labeling the Fc glycans instead of using labeling reagents that target amino or thiol groups. Résidus de bauxite, poussières toxiques, boues polluées, fumées d’incinérateurs, des matières que l’on ne sait pas recycler et qui finissent par contaminer sols, eaux et populations. company_description:
Uniglobe Two Travel @uniglobetwo | 1,024 followers on LinkedIn. UNIGLOBE Two Travel;
It takes TWO to travel           

#TravelWell |  Uniglobe Two Travel maakt deel uit van Uniglobe International, een van de grootste reisfranchise-organisaties ter wereld. Ruim 20 jaar lang verzorgt 'UNIGLOBE Two Travel'​ alle aspecten voor een zakenreis, van vlucht tot hotel, van transfer tot visumservice.

Vanuit 5 lokaties in Nederland (Oud-Beijerland, Sprang-Capelle, Herten, Hoogeveen en Groningen) bedienen wij met name middelgrote bedrijven en organisaties.

profile_projects: [{"description":"In this project, plain weave flax fabric (FF) reinforced unsaturated polyester (USP) matrix-based composites with plain weave basalt fabrics (BF) were fabricated using hand layup method Four different types of composites were fabricated, namely treated FF/USP composites (TFF/USP), untreated FF/USP composites (UFF/USP), basalt fabric reinforced USP (BF/USP) composites and TFF+BF/USP hybrid composites. Physical properties such as density, void percentage and mechanical properties like hardness, Interlaminar Shear Strength (ILSS), tensile, flexural and impact strength were investigated. Scanning Electron Microscope (SEM) was used to examine the fractographic features of the selected composites. Experimental results indicate that tensile, flexural and impact properties of BF/USP composites were higher when compared to untreated and treated FF/USP and hybrid composites. Photomicrographs indicated better fibre-matrix bonding in BF/USP, TFF/USP and hybrid composites indicating improved resistance to delamination. TFF+BF/USP composites proved to be a good compromise between strength and cost effectiveness and they can be used as environmental friendly material for light to moderately loaded structural engineering applications.","end_date":"Jun 2019","start_date":"Aug 2018","title":"Design, fabrication and characterization of a composite material for automotive bumper application"}]

profile_about: Olá e bem-vindo(a) ao meu perfil! Sou apaixonado(a) por lecionar a língua inglesa e tenho dedicado minha carreira ao aprimoramento do ensino para públicos diversos. Com vasta experiência no preparo e ministração de aulas, venho compartilhar meu entusiasmo pelo idioma com alunos em diferentes estágios de aprendizagem. Minhas principais competências incluem: Preparação e ministração de aulas: Busco sempre inovar nas metodologias utilizadas para garantir que as aulas sejam dinâmicas, envolventes e eficazes. Acredito que a educação é um processo contínuo de descoberta mútua entre professor e aluno, e busco sempre estabelecer um ambiente de aprendizado colaborativo. Como profissional, tenho o compromisso de incentivar meus alunos a alcançarem seus objetivos linguísticos, tornando-os confiantes e proficientes em inglês. Acredito que cada estudante é único, e busco conhecer suas necessidades individuais para criar um plano de aprendizado personalizado. Minha abordagem é centrada no aluno, encorajando a participação ativa, a autonomia e a reflexão sobre o processo de aprendizagem. Além disso, valorizo a diversidade cultural e incentivo o uso do idioma como uma ferramenta para a comunicação global. Meu compromisso com o aprimoramento constante me levou a buscar especialização na área de ensino de línguas. Essa formação sólida e atualizada me permite incorporar as mais recentes tendências pedagógicas e recursos tecnológicos em minhas aulas. Convido você a entrar em contato para discutirmos como posso contribuir para seus objetivos de aprendizagem. Vamos juntos alcançar novos horizontes através do poder da língua inglesa!

Protegemos: derechos del consumidor, libre competencia, propiedad industrial y datos personales. | La Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio es una entidad que hace parte del gobierno de Colombia. Nuestra misión es salvaguardar los derechos de los consumidores, proteger la libre y sana competencia, actúar como autoridad nacional de la propiedad industrial y defender los derechos fundamentales relacionados con la correcta administración de datos personales.

De esta manera, la Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio es parte fundamental en la estrategia estatal en favor de la competitividad y la formalización de la economía, lo cual incluye la vigilancia a las cámaras de comercio y la metrología legal en Colombia.

The students spent time across different parts of the facility, and each stop seemed to spark a new set of questions, smiles, and “oh wow” moments. At our Honey packing line, they watched raw, high‑quality honey make its journey from large drums to the neatly sealed yellow-top bottles we all recognise. The students were amazed to see how much science goes into ensuring every single pack of Dabur Honey lives up to our gold‑standard benchmarks. At our Quality Control (QC) laboratory, the excitement doubled as they got a close look at the tools, tests, and technologies our teams use every day to make sure every Dabur product is safe, consistent, and trustworthy. For many of them, it was the first time they saw lab instruments outside their textbooks; and it showed in their wide eyes and animated discussions. What made the day special was how naturally they connected the dots between tradition and technology, understanding how Dabur pairs age‑old goodness with modern science to create products trusted for generations. We’re truly proud to support young learners on their journey from theory to practice, and from curiosity to clarity. Wishing the bright students of Ananda Mohan College all the very best as they continue exploring, learning, and growing. Un chef de file en diplomation. | La CSMB... ancrée dans la diversité montréalaise

Deuxième réseau scolaire en importance au Québec, la Commission scolaire Marguerite-Bourgeoys (CSMB) regroupe près de 52 000 élèves, dont 42 000 au primaire et au secondaire, répartis dans 92 établissements (67 écoles primaires, 13 écoles secondaires, 2 écoles spécialisées, 6 centres de formation professionnelle et 4 centres d’éducation des adultes).

Quelque 8 500 employés (dont 5 000 enseignants) sont au service de cette imposante communauté. Les établissements de la CSMB sont situés dans sept arrondissements montréalais et 13 municipalités de l’ouest de l’île : Lachine, LaSalle, L’Île-Bizard/Sainte-Geneviève, Outremont, Pierrefonds/Roxboro, Saint-Laurent, Verdun, Baie d’Urfé, Beaconsfield, Côte-Saint-Luc, Dollard-Des Ormeaux, Dorval, Hampstead, Kirkland, L’Île-Dorval, Montréal-Ouest, Mont-Royal, Pointe-Claire, Sainte-Anne-de-Bellevue et Senneville.

Com 15 anos de fundação, somos uma empresa de logística em constante busca de alternativas inovadoras, que fornece as seus clientes, confiáveis e rápidos serviços de armazém geral e transporte rodoviário, para qualquer destino. 

CONSISTÊNCIA
Primamos pelo atendimento dos itens críticos para o cliente: baixa sinistralidade; prazos de coleta; tempo de trânsito e prazos de entrega.
DISPONIBILIDADE
Um dos pontos fortes do modal rodoviário em relação aos demais é a disponibilidade de unidades de cargas.

Halkbank | 181,313 followers on LinkedIn. Önce halk, sonra bankayız. | 23 Mayıs 1938 tarihinde faaliyete geçen Halkbank, kuruluşundan bu yana reel sektöre kesintisiz finansal destek misyonuyla çalışarak, bireysel ve kurumsal müşterilerine bankacılık ürün ve hizmetlerini üstün bir kalitede sunmaktadır.

Halkbank, halktan ve çalışanlarından aldığı güç, nitelikli insan kaynağı ve sahip olduğu yenilikçi teknolojiler ile başta esnaf, sanatkar ve KOBİ’ler olmak üzere tüm müşterilerine hızlı, güvenli, kaliteli ürün ve hizmetler sunmak, müşteri odaklı dijital çözümlerle müşteri memnuniyetini artırmak; sosyal sorumluluk bilinciyle ülkemizin gelişmesine ve kalkınmasına destek olarak tüm paydaşlar için yüksek katma değer oluşturmaktadır.

Halkbank, esnafın KOBİ'ye, KOBİ'nin büyük sermaye erbabına dönüşümüne destek olmaktadır.

profile_about: Pursuing B.Com (Hons) from Ram Lal Anand College, University of Delhi, with a strong interest in Finance, Valuation, and Fundamental Business Analysis. I’ve independently worked on financial models and strategic breakdowns of listed companies as a way to understand how businesses truly function beneath the surface. My goal is to build a career in finance — in roles that demand critical thinking, sound judgment, and a deep understanding of how value is created and sustained in a business. A continuous learner, I draw insights from company reports, valuation cases, and numbers. I'm always open to real conversations and meaningful work.

company_description:
The Placement Cell, Ram Lal Anand College | 2,070 followers on LinkedIn. Pathway, The Placement Cell of RLAC, makes the ends meet by helping its students get placed into their dream companies. Pathway is comprised of assiduous and diligent scholars and teachers who go the extra mile to ensure the success of the right candidates.

Over the years, we have hosted recruiters like Byju’s, Amazon, TCS, American Express, PayTm, Accenture, IBM India, EY, KPMG, Kotak Mahindra, Genpact, AON Hewitt, UrbanCompany, and among many others and have helped students get into their dream company through placement drives and internship fairs.

The core activity of AdP group involves the integrated management of the urban water cycle and spanning all of its respective phases, ranging from the capture, treatment and distribution of water for public consumption to the collection, transport, treatment and disposal of urban and industrial wastewaters and including their recycling and reuse.

Through its different companies, the group has a nationwide presence in Portugal, providing services to municipalities that simultaneously serve as shareholders in the companies managing multi-municipal systems (“upstream” systems), and directly serving the populations through municipal systems (“downstream” systems) providing water and sanitation systems.

company_description:
Locala Health & Wellbeing | 2,696 followers on LinkedIn. Locala is a not-for-profit social enterprise that is proud to provide a variety of NHS community healthcare services to people in Kirklees, Calderdale, Bradford and Greater Manchester. 

Those services care for, and support people, from before birth to end of life, ranging from health visitors to physiotherapy, and sexual health to district nursing, as well as dental care, school nurses, and foot care.

We’re a not-for-profit social enterprise, so we are in the great position of having the flexibility to tailor our services to meet the needs of our communities - and any financial surplus is re-invested straight back into supporting patient care.

Not for design or strategy, but for cooking 🧑🍳 Swiggy organised a cooking contest for leaders across the company. The setup was straight out of MasterChef. Individual counters for each team and one shared pantry for vegetables & ingredients. And just like MasterChef, the pantry wasn’t open all the time. If you missed picking an item, you would either need to improvised the dish or use your negotiating skills to barter with other teams. The best part was the mix of people. Every team had leaders with very different titles and levels of authority. From AVPs like me to CXOs who usually sit across very serious tables. But the moment the clock started, things shifted. Titles dissolved, hierarchies softened and everyone became a ‘kitchen-mate’ with a single goal. And the challenges kept coming. For a while, we were allowed to cook using only one hand. Then came a no-fire phase, where all frying had to pause. And at one point, no talking at all. Cooking continued through gestures, eye contact and a lot of frantic hand signals. Constraints everywhere, but somehow, coordination only got sharper. Our assigned dish was Samosa Aloo Tikki Chaat. And no, not just assembling it. This included making the samosas and the tikkis from scratch. Around us, the cooking stations were buzzing. Different teams were working on different assigned dishes. From chaats to ravioli pasta, mezze platters to burritos. You could hear knives hitting chopping boards, oil gently crackling, timers going off and half-finished instructions flying across counters. Execution & coordination mattered. And despite the pressure, it was fun and there was zero ego anywhere. At the end, we plated our dishes and presented them to the judges, chefs and owners from a popular restaurant in Bangalore. They tasted, critiqued and gave feedback in full MasterChef style. Serious enough to feel real, relaxed enough to stay fun 😆 As the photo probably already gave it away, our team won the Best Team award. And honestly, that one felt special because it was a reminder that great teamwork shows up everywhere, even in a kitchen with missing ingredients and ticking clocks. And then came the second trophy, an individual award I genuinely didn’t see coming, titled “The Most Unexpected Outcome” (in a good way 😛). And yes, this one was specifically for plating. I approached the Aloo Tikki Chaat like a fine-dining dish. A single tikki, sliced with almost surgical precision, thoughtfully offset on a wooden platter. Chutneys brushed, dotted and artfully splattered with restraint. Crisp textures, clean negative space and just enough drama to feel intentional rather than indulgent. Basically, I just plated a humble chaat the way five-star hotels do. The kind that charges north of a thousand rupees per plate and confidently calls it “deconstructed.” 😄 Leadership bonding, teamwork, creativity and a gourmet chaat to top it all. Automotive operations

SIRO | 68,064 followers on LinkedIn. Global Leaders in Medical Writing & FSP – 20+ Years, 150+ Experts, One Purpose: Helping Lifesavers Save Lives | SIRO unites two distinct but complementary business units:
🔹 SIRO Medical Writing: 
SIRO's global medical writing specialists excel in drug development across various therapeutic areas & product types, bringing deep expertise in regulatory, clinical, & scientific content with extensive experience in medical & scientific writing. Our medical writing services include:
• Regulatory Medical Writing: Protocols, Investigator's Brochures (IBs), Clinical Study Reports (CSRs), eCTD modules, PIPs/GIPs, Briefing Books, & more.
• Clinical Trial Transparency & Disclosure: Protocol & results registries, document redaction, data anonymization, & lay summaries.
• Scientific Publications & Medical Communications: Manuscripts, review articles, consensus guidelines, abstracts, posters, slide decks, & pre/post-launch communication campaigns for pharmaceutical brands.
• RWE Solutions: Systematic Literature Reviews (SLRs), Targeted Literature Reviews (TLRs), network meta-analyses, value dossiers, & publications.
• DSRM: DSURs, RMPs, SUSAR LLs, PBRERs, PADERs, ACOs, & PSURs.
• Plain Language Summaries (PLSs)
Our vision is to lead medical writing by leveraging expertise, technology, & global reach for unparalleled solutions.

TIC MARIBOR

Their product line includes:

- Annealed, Heat-Strengthened, or Tempered Glass
- Flat and Bent Glass
- Laminated or Monolithic Glass
- Highly Fabricated Glass
- Insulated Glass
- Decorative Glass
- Bullet-Resistant Glazing
- "Smash and Grab Resistant" Glazing
- Transportation Laminates

SBG is committed to providing exceptional customer service, offering unmatched support from the initial quote all the way through to delivery.

The project was initiated by Service Support Operations leaders Tina I. and Nicholas Farley , who sought a way for the team to share resources. As the collection grew, Cassie Blue , a Service Partnerships PM, stepped in to oversee a transformation that was as much about mechanical training as it was about literature. “We saved the van from scrap and turned its cargo bay into a place of knowledge — offering a wide range of genres from self-help and cooking to adventure and comics,” Blue said. “Even better, the vehicle itself serves as a crucial working resource for Service Support Advisors to practice troubleshooting and repair planning inside the Plymouth office.” The decision to retrofit the vehicle was born of a happy problem: the sheer volume of donations. “It’s been amazing to see how supportive Service leadership and my own manager have been of the project,” Blue noted. “About 100 books in, we ran out of shelving, and the idea to retrofit a van came from a simple ‘what if’ conversation with @Corey Walker, Senior Manager, Service Support Operations.” While the van remains a permanent fixture of the Plymouth office, the team is already looking toward the horizon. “While this library isn’t mobile due to its prior testing history, we have hopes for future expansion to other offices and opportunities to make this mobile to local communities,” Blue said. There is a quiet, distinctly Rivian satisfaction in seeing a vehicle be given a new life as part of our office’s culture. It represents a thoughtful sort of circularity: a van that once tested the limits of our hardware now serves to expand the horizons of our people. Haversine Funding | 1,697 followers on LinkedIn. Providing fast, fair and flexible funding solutions to lenders, including participations and senior and junior lines. | Since 2018, Haversine Funding has partnered exclusively with specialty finance lenders - including factors, asset-based lenders, and other commercial finance companies - to help them grow, scale, and navigate every phase of their business.

We provide lender finance solutions, including senior and junior credit facilities up to $30 million, as well as participation funding and select growth capital to help lenders fill funding gaps, manage concentration, and take on larger opportunities. 

We never compete for your borrowers.

I’m a recent graduate with a BS in Social Sciences from the Institute of Management Sciences, Peshawar, where I developed a strong foundation in social issues and community dynamics. Alongside my studies, I actively participated in various student societies and took on leadership roles in organizing campus events.

My volunteer work with the KP Ombudsperson focused on tackling important social challenges like homelessness and environmental justice. I’ve also been part of student-led initiatives aimed at raising awareness about pressing social issues, which reinforced my belief in the impact of collective action.

Through these experiences, I’ve learned the importance of collaboration, effective communication, and the power of community-driven solutions. As I move forward in my career, I’m eager to apply these lessons and contribute to meaningful change.

His defense attorney never asked about his immigration status before advising him to take the plea. For the next 40-plus years, Mr. Munoz lived in fear, doing everything he could to avoid contact with immigration authorities. In August 2022, he came to The Legal Aid Society seeking help with his Section 8 benefits. In September 2023, his immigration attorney persuaded the Kings County District Attorney’s Office to agree that his constitutional rights had been violated — and his plea was vacated. Once that conviction was no longer on his record, our team helped him apply for citizenship, as Mr. Munoz had been a lawful permanent resident for more than fifty years. During the lean season (the period between harvests; October 2024 to March 2025), an estimated 5.7 million people in Malawi experienced crisis levels of food insecurity. What does this mean? Families stopped eating consistently, skipping meals, resulting in an increase in acute malnutrition. To eat, families sold off their assets, such as a prized goat, or a sewing machine, undermining their ability to survive future hardships. Why is this happening? Malawi is living through an economic crisis, with inflation driving up the cost of food and fuel. Compounding the problem are low education levels (only 51% of children complete primary school), high prevalence of HIV/AIDs, and high rates of stunting; the life-long legacy of childhood malnutrition. A farming nation, Malawi has been hit particularly hard by climate change, with the frequency and intensity of extreme weather events increasing. Pictured is Fanny, and her granddaughter Tania. Fanny was able to buy rabbits after joining her local Village Savings and Loans Association (VSLA). People living in conditions of extreme poverty struggle to access credit through formal lending institutions. To remedy this problem, Concern and Irish Aid are establishing VSLAs in Malawi. Neighbours commit savings to a mutual fund and issue each other small loans. They can open a business, rebuild after a storm - or buy a family of rabbits. Why rabbits? Rabbits are a rich source of protein, and potential income. Over time, the sale of offspring or mature rabbits allows families to purchase other essentials, reinvest in their farm, or cope with shocks such as crop failure. Rabbits are ideal for Fanny because they require minimal space, feed, and veterinary care compared to other livestock. Through the stories of the people we work with, learn about the impact of Concern and Irish Aid in Malawi. But despite the noise, I believe something quieter—and more profound—is happening: people are still showing up for one another. They show up when wildfires displace communities, when a blood drive supports a child battling cancer, when a military member and their family faces deployment or hardship, and when a stranger simply needs a helping hand. They show up amid the relentless hustle and bustle not because they share the same circumstances or viewpoints, but because they believe in something deeper: the power of compassion. I’ve seen this firsthand through the American Red Cross . In moments of crisis, Americans drop everything and travel across the country to hand out blankets and water. They roll up their sleeves to donate blood or to provide CPR to someone in cardiac arrest. They act because someone needs help. This is who we are. We're a Nation where empathy drives action, and where the pressures and challenges of daily life don’t override our capacity to care for one another. Whether in a small rural town or a busy urban center, the instinct to help transcends geography. We may go about our days differently, but we’re not so different when it comes to showing up for each other. And right now, when it’s easier than ever to burn out, tune out or shut down, that instinct matters even more. Our strength as a nation has long come from our ability to come together—especially when the stakes are high. We can choose connection. We can choose kindness. We can choose to show up. The organization I lead sees this every day. Volunteers, donors, and neighbors stepping up—not because they have time to, but because they choose to. That choice matters. As I've been working closely with hip-hop communities for the last 8 years, this shift has been visible for a while. What’s changing now is both scale and mainstream acceptance. From an artist’s lens, one reminder stands out: hip-hop isn’t just tech-enabled creativity; it’s lived language. Flow, pronunciation, and cultural context still matter, though it's a great try to do at mass scale. At MARS Management (Events & Artists) & Our #TheMarsian agency, we work at this exact intersection – helping brands integrate hip-hop through real artists, writers, and communities, so storytelling feels native, not generated. Great to see music-led storytelling becoming part of everyday product experiences now! PETROJET | 211,527 followers on LinkedIn. THE PETROLEUM PROJECTS & TECHNICAL CONSULTATIONS COMPANY | The Petroleum Projects and Technical Consultations Company
 
PETROJET is the largest state-owned joint-stock company in the Egyptian construction market established in 1975 as one of the Egyptian Petroleum Sector Companies providing Engineering, Procurement and Construction services as a multidisciplinary integrated construction contractor offering a diversified spectrum of services related to the Oil, Gas, Petrochemical, Infrastructure and Industrial Sectors in Egypt, Middle East and Africa.
With over 45 years of experience, a workforce of 40000 employees, a modern fleet of construction equipment and state-of-the-art technology,and the leading in terms of accreditation with Nuclear Stamps "N, NPT, NS and NA"​, in addition to ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 17025, OHSAS 18001, ASME Stamps, and API monogram.

PETROJET is ranked nowadays one of the major EPC contractors in the MEA region.

Vect-Horus designs and develops vectors that facilitate targeting and delivery of therapeutic or imaging agents to organs, including the brain and tumours. Vect-Horus combines these different agents to its vectors that specifically target various receptors, allowing these agents to cross natural barriers (first and foremost the blood-brain-barrier) which limit access of therapeutic or imaging agents to their targets. The proof of concept of the technology has already been established in animal models using different vectorized molecules.

Cylus | 9,707 followers on LinkedIn. Secure Every System. Keep Rail in Motion. | Cylus provides rail operators with a specialized cybersecurity solution for operational rail technology systems, ensuring service availability and safety. Combining deep expertise in rail and cybersecurity, Cylus has pioneered a comprehensive rail tech security platform that delivers real-time asset visibility and threat detection and response capabilities across heterogeneous operational rail technology environments. 

Delivering deep rail context and rail framework compliance to customers across the globe, Cylus is leading the way with a cybersecurity solution that reduces risks and ensures compliance in the face of escalating cyber threats.

An Aircraft Dispatcher is a FAA licensed airman whose primary concern is safety and performs the following tasks:

An Aircraft Dispatcher shares equal and joint responsibility with the pilot in command for the safety and operational control of the flight.

An Aircraft Dispatcher authorizes, regulates, controls and terminates aircraft flights in accordance with company and governmental regulations and policies to ensure safety.

An Aircraft Dispatcher is responsible for the economics, operational control, and passenger service requirements for daily flight operations.

An Aircraft Dispatcher reviews and evaluates weather information to determine potential flight safety hazards and to select the preferred and most economical route of flight.

An Aircraft Dispatcher computes the amount of fuel required, distance of flight, maintenance limitations, weather conditions, and other factors affecting safety of flight using company and FAA established guidelines.

An Aircraft Dispatcher prepares flight plans with information including maximum allowable takeoff and landing weights, weather reports, field conditions, METARs, TAFs, NOTAMs, PIREPs, and other information required for the safe completion of the flight.

An Aircraft Dispatcher prepares and signs the dispatch release which is a legal document providing authorization for the flight to depart.

An Aircraft Dispatcher is authorized by the FAA to delay, divert, or cancel a flight if unsafe conditions pose a threat to the safety of the aircraft, passengers, cargo or flight.

An Aircraft Dispatcher monitors weather conditions, aircraft position reports, aeronautical navigation charts and aircraft radio calls to evaluate the progress and safety of the flight.

When the topsoil moves, it triggers a cascade of failures that chemistry alone can't fix. 1️⃣ NUTRIENT LOSS Erosion is a picky thief. It doesn't wash away random dirt; it selectively strips the lightweight organic matter and fine clay particles first. Since these components hold 90% of your soil's fertility (CEC), leaving behind a skeleton of inert sand that can't hold onto the fertilizer you apply. 2️⃣ SURFACE CRUSTING When soil aggregates fall apart, heavy rains turn the surface into a slurry. As it dries, the fine particles settle and lock together to form a hard, impermeable crust. This "concrete cap" physically blocks seedlings from breaking through (emergence failure) and seals the surface, forcing valuable rainwater to run off the field instead of soaking in. 3️⃣ POOR ANCHORAGE & LODGING RISK physically thins this layer, forcing plants to grow in a shallow soil environment. It causes a higher susceptibility to lodging during wind events because the roots simply don't have enough soil depth to anchor the plant against the leverage of the stalk. 4️⃣ SUBSOIL TOXICITY & ROOT RESTRICTION Physical scouring reduces the effective rooting depth, limiting the volume of soil a plant can explore for water. Worse, severe erosion exposes the B-horizon (subsoil), which is often chemically hostile, containing high levels of toxic aluminum or carbonates that chemically burn root tips and lock out micronutrients. 🛡️ Microbes as ‘soil architects’ This is where biology becomes your best engineering tool. Provincie West-Vlaanderen | 11,009 followers on LinkedIn. De gedreven provincie. | Om West-Vlaanderen nog sterker, beter en aantrekkelijker  te maken, focust het provinciebestuur sinds 2018 op haar grondgebonden opdrachten. 

Onze waardevolle West-Vlaamse grond verdient respect, met een duurzaam gebruik van de schaarse en dus waardevolle ruimte: leefbare woonkernen, goed uitgeruste bedrijventerreinen, voldoende landbouwgrond, waardevolle natuur, droge voeten en duurzame energie. Als een ervaren regisseur en bouwheer zorgt het provinciebestuur dat natuur, grond en water optimaal gebruikt worden, zodat onze provincie verder kan groeien.

This is a particularly large and unusual cluster of cases, with the Department typically only treating a handful a year of such cases at most. Spinal meningioma is a benign tumor that grows within the membranes surrounding the spinal cord. The tumor, which is more common in older women, places pressure on the spinal cord and nerves, leading to various symptoms in the arms and legs, including tingling, limb weakness, walking difficulties, and in the most extreme cases leading to paralysis. Gila, one of the women who was operated upon said: “For months, I had been suffering from tingling in my legs and had fallen several times. My quality of life had deteriorated dramatically whereby I could take only one step every three hours. The tingling didn’t go away and even worsened to the point that my left leg had become almost completely paralyzed. I had been to other medical appointments other than at Shaare Zedek but they hadn’t identified the problem. Only when coming to Shaare Zedek and after Dr. Mordechai Lynn from the Neurology Department ordered an MRI scan, were they able to determine that I had a benign tumor in my spine the size of a tennis ball. The tumor was removed in surgery, and immediately afterward my condition began to improve and I could move my left leg. Thanks to the amazing team of doctors and nurses at Shaare Zedek, I can now do things I couldn’t do before. I have never received such care from a medical team — they are simply angels, I have no other word. I didn’t even want to leave the hospital because the experience was so positive.” Dr. Gustavo Rajz (pictured below), a Senior Neurosurgeon in the Helmsley Brain Center who performed all four surgeries, explained, “Over the years, I have never encountered such a high number of women diagnosed with spinal meningioma requiring surgery within such a short period. Prof. Hashkes, a long-time renowned figure in the Israeli medical community, was presented the award this past week at the annual meeting of the ACR in Chicago. This distinguished honor is awarded to College members credited with making significant contributions to the field of rheumatology, achieved outstanding academic accomplishments, and served their patients and students with excellence. Prof. Hashkes is one of only 16 physicians worldwide selected to receive this prestigious honor for 2025. Prof. Hashkes said, “I am deeply humbled and grateful to the ACR for selecting me for this recognition. Throughout my career in Israel and the U.S., I have had the privilege of learning from, collaborating with, and teaching wonderful colleagues from around the world — including numerous pioneers and leaders in the fields of pediatric rheumatology and autoinflammatory diseases. I view this award also as tribute to the high level of rheumatology and clinical care provided to diverse populations in Israel, and I am especially grateful to have contributed to the rapid growth of pediatric rheumatology in Israel.” In addition to his role at Shaare Zedek he also serves as the Chair of the Israeli Society for Pediatric Rheumatology. Prof. Hashkes began his medical career studying at the Hebrew University Faculty of Medicine, later specializing in Pediatrics, and in 1994 continued with a fellowship in Pediatric Rheumatology at Cincinnati Children’s Hospital. Upon returning to Israel, he worked as a physician at Ziv, Poriya, and Emek Medical Centers, where he established new pediatric rheumatology clinics. From there, he was recruited to head the Pediatric Rheumatology Unit at the Cleveland Clinic, one of the world’s most prestigious hospitals. In 2009, he assumed his current role at the Pediatric Rheumatology Unit at Shaare Zedek. In addition, Prof. Hashkes is an Associate Professor at the Hebrew University Faculty of Medicine. His main fields of interest and research include arthritis treatment, vasculitis (blood vessel diseases), and auto-inflammatory diseases, including Familial Mediterranean Fever (FMF). He has published around 200 scientific articles, some in leading international journals, and authored chapters in major textbooks in the field. He also served as Chief Editor of the first textbook dedicated to auto-inflammatory diseases, and represents rheumatology on the editorial board of the Journal of Pediatrics. The study, funded with support from The Leona M. and Harry B. Charitable Trust, was conducted across 17 medical centers around the world to test the efficacy of the Tasty&Healthy (T&H) whole food diet ( https://tasty-healthy.com ) as compared to the Exclusive Enteral Nutrition (EEN) diet, which had previously been viewed as the dietary standard for younger Crohn's patients. “At Helmsley, our focus is on meeting the real-world needs of people living with Crohn’s disease,” said Shefali Soni, Program Officer at the Helmsley Charitable Trust. “We recognize that navigating diet is one of the most difficult aspects of daily life for patients and families. We’re excited to support this research on the Tasty&Healthy diet, which has the potential to make a meaningful difference in their care.” Prof. Dan Turner, Director of Pediatric Gastroenterology at Shaare Zedek said, “This study served as the first randomized trial to prove the effectiveness of an exclusive whole food diet diet as an alternative to EEN, with the understanding that the T&H diet can be a far more manageable and accesible option for many patients. We are confident that the findings of this study will open the door for far more widespread integration of the T&H diet in ways that will significantly better the lives of children and families coping with Crohn's and pave the way for other studies." The study found that patients reported far higher levels of tolerability to T&H foods as compared to EEN (88% versus 52%) while experiencing comparable clinical and biological remission rates. Patients on the T&H diet exhibited a healthier microbiome showing increased diversity and enrichment of healthy species. The study further showed the two diets offered similar improvements in inflammation markers and overall quality of life. The study came alongside the release of the latest Hebrew edition of the “Tasty&Healthy” cookbook, which provides a collection of recommendations and recipes that integrates the basic principles of the T&H diet to enable individuals with digestive disorders to enjoy a wider variety of food without the harmful side effects that typically come with these conditions. The book has recipes and dietary guidance for people coping with Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, celiac and lactose intolerance. The book was authored by Chef Omer Miller and Culinary Consultant Elinoar Rabin together with Prof. Turner and the dietician Luba Plotkin. All proceedings from the sales of this charity book will go to support further research benefiting Crohn's patients. Solusi Finansial Untuk Berbagai Kebutuhan ASN di Seluruh Indonesia | PT Fidac Inovasi Teknologi adalah perusahaan Financial Technology berbasis Peer to Peer Lending (P2P) berlisensi OJK yang hadir menjadi solusi bagi ASN dalam memenuhi kebutuhan finansial. 

PT Fidac Inovasi Teknologi selaku perusahaan yang mengelola produk Dumi berkomitmen memberikan layanan pendanaan yang menjadi solusi bagi pegawai pemerintahan dalam memenuhi kebutuhan darurat dan modal usaha.

Dalam 5 tahun Dumi telah dipercaya oleh puluhan ribu ASN dari ribuan instansi pemerintah di Indonesia dan menyalurkan dana lebih dari Rp4,3 Triliun untuk modal usaha, renovasi rumah, biaya pendidikan anak dan masih banyak lagi.

Edited"],"repost_id":"7348395496811433984","repost_text":"Compartilhando dois casos recentes que demonstram a importância da avaliação musculoesquelética detalhada para um diagnóstico preciso, ambos realizados com um aparelho Canon Aplio 300 e transdutor de 14mHz: Caso 1: Paciente de 63 anos com dor no antebraço, braço e cotovelo (20 dias). Suspeita neurocirúrgica de neuropatia. A avaliação revelou trombose aguda da veia basílica. Caso 2: Paciente de 53 anos com dor no punho esquerdo, 2º e 3º raios digitais e região tenar (1 mês), com suspeita de síndrome do túnel do carpo pelo médico assistente. O exame identificou oclusão total das artérias radial e ulnar distais por trombos recentes, com fluxo colateral palmar preservado. Esses casos ilustram como uma avaliação completa, com o uso de tecnologia adequada, pode identificar condições inesperadas e guiar o tratamento adequado. #AvaliaçãoMusculoesquelética #DiagnósticoPorImagem #CasosClínicos #Ortopedia #CanonMedical #Ultrassom Sharing two recent cases that highlight the importance of detailed musculoskeletal evaluation for accurate diagnosis. Both assessments were performed using a Canon Aplio 300 system with a 14mHz transducer: Case 1: A 63-year-old patient with forearm, arm, and elbow pain (20 days). Neurosurgical suspicion of neuropathy. The evaluation revealed acute basilic vein thrombosis. Bancorbrás | 50,403 followers on LinkedIn. Com mais de 33 anos de atuação no mercado brasileiro, a Bancorbrás ganhou visibilidade nos ramos de consórcio, seguro e turismo ao oferecer a milhares de pessoas facilidades para realizarem alguns de seus projetos de vida.

Criada em 13 de julho de 1983 a partir dos ideais de um grupo de funcionários do Banco do Brasil e do Banco Central, no decorrer dos anos a Bancorbrás promoveu diversas reformulações estruturais e de gestão, investiu na capacitação de seu contingente de colaboradores e buscou inovar com vistas a atender, de forma eficiente e eficaz, seus clientes e acionistas.

A Bancorbrás tem sede em Brasília e possui filiais, representações comerciais e agências credenciadas nas principais capitais do País.

ITW - Better Systems, Better Business | 2,593 followers on LinkedIn. Aseguramos que la calidad y confiabilidad del software sea una realidad | En ITW llevamos más de 11 años reduciendo el rango de error en software y aplicaciones, durante este tiempo y a lo largo de nuestra historia hemos dedicado nuestro esfuerzo y conocimiento en ser lideres en QA en México y Latinoamérica. Estamos logrando una mejor experiencia para los usuarios de aplicaciones móviles en la industria financiera y tecnológica- Hoy contamos con más de 200 colaboradores a lo largo del territorio Mexicano , Brindándoles todo el apoyo para crecer como personas así como profesionales, Nuestra misión es hacer que nuestros clientes tengan la tranquilidad de crear e innovar en sus aplicativos y estructuras tecnológicas, mientras nosotros aseguramos que la calidad y confiabilidad de su software sea una realidad.

Nuestros principales servicios son, Ejecución de Pruebas, Automatización de pruebas y RPA, implementación de modelos de QA, así como productos y herramientas de vanguardia para las tareas de Calidad.

regarder en face les défis qui s’annoncent. La deuxième édition des Rencontres Santé & Prévoyance Diot-Siaci a rassemblé décideurs, experts et partenaires assureurs autour d’une conviction partagée : l’avenir de notre système de santé et de son financement se joue autour de la capacité à innover, à anticiper et à agir collectivement. Le constat réalisé par Josette Guéniau (JGSC), Guillaume Pleynet-Jésus ( GROUPAMA GAN VIE ) et Laurent Jumelle ( MSH ), est clair : 💸 Les dépenses s’envolent, la prévalence des maladies chroniques s’accélère, et la pression sur la sécurité sociale se renforce toujours plus. 🤝 La soutenabilité de nos systèmes de protection sociale n’est pas un enjeu relevant de la puissance publique seule. Les complémentaires santé et les courtiers, sont appelés à jouer un rôle de premier plan : financièrement mais également sur le plan de la gestion des risques et du conseil auprès des assurés, dans un dialogue renouvelé sur toute la chaine de valeur de l’assurance. 🔍 Le virage préventif s’impose comme un des leviers privilégiés pour garantir la pérennité de notre système de santé. 💡 Dans ce contexte, et au-delà des obligations légales qui s’imposent à eux, les employeurs sont de plus en plus des relais de proximité vers lesquels les salariés se tournent en matière de prévention et d’accompagnement. Des solutions innovantes existent dans chaque collectif pour répondre aux besoins qui s’expriment. L’intelligence artificielle s’invite dans le débat : menace ou opportunité ? Si l’IA promet une gestion plus efficace et plus individualisée, l’intervention portée par Dhouha GAAYA , MSH , et Mathieu Bremond , Diot-Siaci , a mis en lumière l’utilisation de l’ #IA comme outil indispensable pour se protéger contre la fraude et réaliser une analyse des dépenses plus fine. - Servei de telegestió
- Enllumenat públic
- Obra pública
- Manteniment integral de piscines.

Throughout its 30-year history, Equinox continues to lead and disrupt the category it singularly defined, operating over 100 full-service fitness clubs globally across major U.S. cities including New York, Los Angeles, Miami and San Francisco as well as London, Toronto and Vancouver, each featuring bespoke design in an unparalleled luxury environment.

A Bosch Group company, BSH Home Appliances Corporation produces and markets small and major home appliances that are known across North America for their high-quality and superior innovation. Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company Limited (Chola), founded in 1978 as part of the Murugappa Group, initially focused on equipment financing. company_description:
CONMED Corporation | 335,684 followers on LinkedIn. CONMED is a global medical technology company that specializes in the development and sale of surgical and patient monitoring products and services that allow our physician customers to deliver high quality care and as a result, enhanced clinical outcomes for their patients.

With products that are recognized as technological leaders by the specialties they serve, healthcare professionals within the Orthopedic, Laparoscopic, Robotic & Open Surgery, Gastroenterology & Pulmonology and Cardiology & Critical Care specialties have come to value the CONMED name across the world.

Our Mission is to enable healthcare providers around the world to deliver exceptional outcomes for patients, through accessible CONMED solutions.

He dedicated his life to uplifting people whose voices are not always heard, and he understood the critical importance of education and social justice. His work on the State Board capped a decades-long legacy serving the community and technical college system that also included 30 years of teaching at Yakima Valley College and 10 years in government relations for the American Federation of Teachers Washington. To his core, Bernal believed in racial equity, a tenet central to the community and technical college system’s vision. Even in his final days, he worked tirelessly on behalf of Latino and Indigenous families and communities, serving as the executive director of the Tacoma-based Mi Centro, executive committee member of the Washington State Hispanic Affairs Commission, member of the Racial Equity Team, and co-founder and board member of the Equity in Education Coalition. In low CEC soils (often sandy soils), nutrients wash away more quickly, requiring frequent, targeted fertilization to maintain crop health. 3️⃣ Why CEC Matters to Farmers & Agronomists Soils with different CEC levels require different fertilization approaches. High CEC soils store more nutrients, reducing the need for frequent applications, but may require pH adjustments to maintain nutrient availability. Low CEC soils demand precise, frequent fertilization strategies to prevent nutrient loss through leaching. 4️⃣ How to Increase Soil CEC and Nutrient Retention For low-CEC soils, applying fertilizers in smaller, more frequent doses and incorporating organic matter helps boost retention. For high-CEC soils, utilizing larger but less frequent fertilizer applications and monitoring pH levels maintains optimal nutrient availability. Soil testing is essential—it provides critical CEC data and precise fertilizer recommendations. Clean contours, assertive geometry, a taste for contrasts and materials: the codes of Art Deco shaped the 1920s and 1930s. One event in particular sealed this aesthetic revolution: the 1925 International Exhibition of Modern Decorative and Industrial Arts. There, amid the creative fervor that would give the movement its name, Boucheron emerged as a leading voice of Art Deco. At the heart of this inventive period, the Maison produced a prolific body of jewelry and objets d’art that tell the story of this style and, even more, of interwar society itself. In those years, the Maison laid the foundations of an aesthetic language that still resonates in its contemporary creations a century later. In 2025, to mark the movement’s centenary, Boucheron will unveil an exceptional selection from its private collection in two major retrospectives. From October 4, 2025 to January 4, 2026, the Nakanoshima Museum of Art in Osaka presents “The Venus of a New Age! Celebrating the 100th Anniversary of Art Deco,” featuring twenty-six archival pieces from the Maison. The retrospective highlights cosmopolitan influences - Japanese lacquer vanity cases, jewels inspired by India including a commission from the Maharaja of Bikaner, and exceptional works in jade - through the lens of the garçonne, an “Art Deco Venus” embodying freedom and modernity. From October 22, 2025 to April 26, 2026, the Musée des Arts Décoratifs in Paris presents “1925–2025. One Hundred Years of Art Deco,” featuring seven Boucheron pieces that showcase the movement’s palette and textures: rock crystal in pure transparency, black enamel for contrast, greens from jade, tourmaline, and emerald, and rare snakewood. A 1925 bodice ornament with a silk tassel anchors the story, its sculptural hardstones forming a mineral mosaic that epitomizes the era. Las técnicas de secuenciación son herramientas fundamentales para la identificación temprana de microorganismos de interés, y el análisis de las secuencias obtenidas es clave para una interpretación precisa de los datos. A través de este curso, el ICGES brindó capacitación al personal de instituciones de salud internacionales para la implementación, desarrollo y fortalecimiento de sus habilidades en la preparación de librerías, el uso de tecnología de secuenciación de nueva generación (NGS) y el análisis de datos genómicos. El acto de clausura contó con la participación del Dr. Nicanor Obaldía Rodríguez, Director General del Instituto Conmemorativo Gorgas de Estudios de la Salud ( ICGES), el Honorable Señor Shohei Tada, Representante Residente de JICA en Panamá; la Dra. Ana Rivière Cinnamond, Representante de la OPS/OMS en Panamá; la Dra. María Eugenia Barnett de Antinori, Subdirectora General del ICGES y el Licenciado Javier Smith, Director de Administración y Finanzas del ICGES. El curso se llevó a cabo del 13 al 24 de octubre de 2025 en las instalaciones del ICGES, con la participación de ocho estudiantes internacionales y profesionales de Centroamérica, Suramérica y el Caribe. Solas Marine Services Group | 23,101 followers on LinkedIn. 30 years of Complete Solutions | SOLAS Marine Services Group is a diversified group of companies that commenced its operations in the year 1988. It was first established in Sharjah, United Arab Emirates to meet the growing demands of professional services in the field of Life Saving Appliances (LSA) and Fire Fighting Appliances (FFA) along with Safety Equipment's in Marine Industry.

Over the years, Solas Marine Services has evolved as a major service provider in the region not only for LSA and FFA but also diversified into new areas like System Integration, Hydraulics, Cranes, Navigation & Communications for Marine and Oil & Gas Industry.

This eventually led us to look at a strong, playful and eye-catching concept. Since we are stamp collectors and true football (soccer) lovers we thought we could combine these two on a project. This gave us and exciting opportunity to invent unique compositions, which we believe can create strong emotional responses. Before the design process began, we needed to agree on what our goals were for the brief and what we were hoping to achieve — a travel across every national team with a matchless personality. With Motion as the main principle — sense of traveling and sport. It felt natural and the most logical approach creating a diagonal based grid system, it helps with the visual rhythm but it also gave the composition formal context — energy, suggesting a feeling of movement, feeling of activity and it also indicates depth. Since we had to represent 32 nations and color is naturally emotive we choose just 12 colors (including variations) to form a strong and balanced aesthetic, the most obvious advantage is that it gives them a distinguishable unique visual language.
